name: Himenogi Rinze
source: A girl who does not smile and is always alone. She is mature and somewhat dark. She loves gymnastics and trains enthusiastically. When she is bored, she kills the time studying in the library. For that reason, she has good grades. Those around her praise her as a diligent honors student, but she does not think that herself. She dislikes her classmates’ childish behavior.
